blocks.text: Wake up to the spectacle of the Amazon sunrise. After breakfast, take part in a trek to a riverside community, exploring biodiversity and discovering ancient medicinal plants. After lunch, feel the essence of the Amazon on a canoe trip along the Aruau River. Experience the nocturnal fauna and after dinner, get ready for the exclusive "Sensory Experience".

After breakfast, go on a boat trip to interact with the charming pink dolphins. Visit and understand the culture of the Tuyuka indigenous community. With a full heart and mind, returns to Manaus after lunch,
